item.title: [WHAT-IF] Azure AI Foundry - Central India - Service unavailable
item.description:
Impact Statement: Starting at 12:05 UTC on 27 Feb 2026, customers using Azure AI Foundry model deployments in Central India may be unable to access model deployments and may receive HTTP 503 errors.

Current Status: Engineers are investigating. The next update will be provided within 60 minutes.

item.title: [WHAT-IF] Azure Storage - West Europe - Elevated latency
item.description: Customers in West Europe may experience elevated latency for blob uploads.
